description.text: BUCT Introduction Established in 1958, Beijing University of Chemical Technology (BUCT) is a key university directly under the Ministry of Education in China. The Chinese International Education Center began to recruit both long-term and short-term international students in 1993. Up to now, it has enrolled over 5,000 students, including the politicians from the embassies of Canada, Thailand, Equatorial Guinea and Saudi Arabia, as well as their relatives. The students studying here come from 70-plus countries all over the world. With the rapid development of the BUCT, a multi-level talent training pattern has taken shape in this part of the world, covering language programs and degree programs (for undergraduate, master and doctoral students). Course Introduction BUCT offers Chinese learning coursefor Chinese learning to help international students develop various language skills in such aspects as comprehensive Chinese, speaking, listening, reading, writing and HSK courses etc. Advantages of Online Teaching 1.Strong teacher team and scientific teaching arrangement 2.Customized small-class courses and dedicated learning guidance 3.Flexible in when and where to take classes 4.Low learning cost and rich learning content 5.Practical certificate of completion and valid course credits How to Teach Teaching live online By virtue of platform and Apps like zhumu and WeChat

duration.text: The Short-term Chinese Language Course at Beijing University of Chemical Technology is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1145 USD/per semester ￥ 8250 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1. Application Form (template) 2. A clearly scanned copy of the personal information page on the valid passport in color. 3. A clearly scanned copy of the high school graduation certificate. 4. A scanned copy of the high school academic transcript for the entire high school period. 5. Proof of Chinese or English proficiency (HSK; IELTS, TOEFL, Duolinguo, SAT, GRE and other proofs of English proficiency) 6. Physical Examination Certificate issued within the last 6 months 7. Non-criminal record certificate issued within last 5 months List of other application materials for foreign students in China: 1. A clearly scanned copy of the personal information page on the valid visa in color 2. Letter of good conduct 3. Study certificate

requirements.text: 1.Applicants must be citizens of nations other than China and in good health condition. 2.Applicants should at least hold a high school diploma and be not older than 50; 3.Applicants should have no any illegal records in China.
